proposal.reason: Main change is contribution/review automation behavior in .github scripts and workflows: review_automation.py and maintainer_approval.py alter module-routing, invitation withdrawal, and Reviewer+Maintainer approval gate logic, while commit_message_squash.py and commit-message.yml tie squash-preview publication to PCCL Review Gate status. The SKILL.md and modules.json edits are policy/catalog guidance supporting the same workflow system, not separate runtime module changes.
